description: File a bug, surprise, or workaround you hit this session as a GitHub issue on the aidemo engine repo (github.com/tandryukha/aidemo) — the in-band equivalent of `aidemo feedback` on the CLI. Environment (engine version, OS, node, ffmpeg) and a recent-log tail from `dir` are auto-attached, same as the CLI. Uses `gh issue create` when available; falls back to a local docs/feedback-*.md plus a prefilled github.com New Issue URL when gh is missing or offline — no other network call. Call this whenever something felt broken, surprising, or needed a workaround; skip it if the session was clean. Set dryRun to preview the assembled title/body without filing anything.

body.description: what happened / suggestion — the actual finding (broken selector, bad timing, confusing behavior, an idea). Environment/log context is appended automatically; don't duplicate it here.

dir.description: demo dir to pull storyboard/log context from (recommended)

dryRun.description: assemble the title/body but don't file anything — preview only

web.description: prefer a prefilled browser New Issue URL over filing via gh

name: feedback
title: File engine feedback
